Fountainhead
Design System

One source of truth for colour, type, and components — built straight from the brand guidelines. Framework-agnostic CSS that drops into the website, the ERP apps, and anything else we build. Light, dark, and a compact density for data-heavy screens.

Blue #005BAA Red #B8292F Yellow #F2C418 Montserrat + Nunito

Logo

Full-colour on light, white on dark. Keep clearspace; never tilt, recolour, or add containers.

Colour

Three brand colours. Two bases (blue + red) at ~45% each, yellow accent at ~10%.

    Field & paper patterns

    Grades, attendance, calendars, identity — and print. Full screen compositions live in erp-archetypes.html (form · detail · wizard · grid · attendance · calendar · map · settings · comms) and erp-print.html (receipt · report · ID card).

    Grade chips · .fh-grade--1…7 (1 is red-tinted; --na = not assessed) — for grids, gradebooks, report sheets

    12 34 56 7– pair with .fh-table--frozen-first + .fh-table__center for the students × subjects grid

    Attendance marks · .fh-mark (--present --absent --late) — tap-friendly daily-marking toggles

    Print · .fh-sheet (+ --a5 --card)

    Paper documents (receipts, report sheets, ID cards) preview on screen and print clean — app chrome auto-hides under @media print. Templates: erp-print.html. The mobile drawer (.fh-appshell--drawer) and map chrome (.fh-mapframe) are shell-level — see the archetype pages.

    Product / ERP patterns

    Toggle Profile: product in the top bar — body text switches to a crisp UI font, secondary text tightens, and numerals go tabular. The print brand is for impact; this is the operational counterpart.

    Filter toolbar · .fh-toolbar + .fh-select--auto (controls size to content, wrap gracefully)
    Calmer KPI tones · .fh-stat--danger/warning/success (value uses the darker text token, not full-saturation brand)

    Data-viz fills · soft tokens (.fh-color-*-soft) for large areas; keep saturated brand only for small accents/text
    danger-soft warning-soft success-soft
    Diverging scale · .fh-color-diverging-* for signed deltas (over ↔ exact ↔ under) — valence-neutral, soft mids, strong ends for magnitude
    Quality scale · .fh-color-scale-quality-1…6 (best→worst) for ordinal categories that must stay distinguishable in a stack — color alone must never carry ordinal meaning via a single-hue ramp; grade chips (.fh-grade--1…7) are exempt since the digit itself carries the signal
    Reference line · .fh-color-chart-reference for benchmarks / targets / world-average markers (neutral — never a data series)
